title: “Ingeniero,” CJNG Member Who Designed and Built Narco-Tunnels, Falls in Zapopan
author: SinEmbargo Staff
content:
_This article by SinEmbargo staff originally appeared in the[October 16, 2026
edition of SinEmbargo](https://www.sinembargo.mx/4888849/ingeniero-miembro-
del-cjng-que-disenaba-y-construia-narcotuneles-cae-en-zapopan/), an
independent Mexican digital news outlet._

_According to what was stated by the Defense Secretariat, "Ingeniero" received
direct orders from Juan Carlos Valencia González, current head of the CJNG._

**Mexico City, October 16 (SinEmbargo).—** Mexico's **Secretariat of National
Defense** reported that, following an operation, it achieved the arrest in the
municipality of **Zapopan, Jalisco** , of **Luis Manuel "N," alias
"Ingeniero,"** who is identified as a member of the **[Jalisco New Generation
Cartel (CJNG)](https://www.sinembargo.mx/4847925/tras-la-caida-del-mencho-
cual-es-la-nueva-estructura-criminal-del-cjng/).**

> "As a result of work by the Central Military Intelligence of the Secretariat
> of National Defense, on October 15 of this year, personnel of the National
> Guard in coordination with the Mexican Army and the Criminal Investigation
> Agency of the Attorney General's Office arrested Luis Manuel 'N,'
> 'Ingeniero,' in flagrante delicto in the municipality of Zapopan, Jalisco,"
> the Defense Secretariat stated in a [press
> release](https://www.gob.mx/defensa/prensa/se-informa-sobre-la-detencion-de-
> luis-manuel-n-a-ingeniero-perteneciente-al-cartel-jalisco-nueva-generacion).

The agency indicated that the individual is considered a key member of the
CJNG, as he was in charge of the design and construction of **tunnels used for
drug trafficking between Mexico and the United States (US)** , especially in
the municipality of **Tijuana, Baja California**.

It also highlighted that the detainee, who faces charges in the US for the
crime of conspiracy to traffic drugs, operated under the direct orders of
**Juan Carlos Valencia González, alias "03" or "Pelón,"** who is identified as
the current leader of the criminal group.

"During the operation, weapons, drugs and a vehicle were seized; the detainee
and the seized items were placed at the disposal of the Attorney General's
Office based in Guadalajara, Jal., to continue with the investigations and the
corresponding forensic procedures and to determine his legal situation," the
Defense Secretariat noted.

## What Is the Current Structure of the CJNG?

The Jalisco New Generation Cartel has a new criminal structure, and the United
States Government has put a price on it that exceeds **100 million dollars**.

In August, after the fall of "El Mencho," the US State Department announced
the new amounts for the leaders of this criminal organization. The information
included the update of the sums offered, the addition of other kingpins to the
most-wanted list and the designation of a new public enemy number one.

At the top of the criminal leadership is Juan Carlos Valencia González, alias
"El Pelón," as top leader. The stepson of "El Mencho" is now the most wanted
drug trafficker, with a reward of **25 million dollars**.

Next on the list are Gonzalo Mendoza Gaytán, "El Sapo," and Audias Flores
Silva, "El Jardinero." The US government put a price of 15 million dollars on
each of their heads.

On a third level are Carlos Andrés Rivera Varela, "La Firma," Francisco Javier
Gudiño Haro, "La Gallina," Julio César Montero Pinzón, "El Tarjetas," and
Julio Alberto Castillo Rodríguez, "El Chorro."
